senses.gloss: f. (צעה, denom. of יָצַע, to lie down, to banquet, v. צָעָא) banqueting dish, plate.—Pl. צוּעוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:3:2">Y. Keth. X, 33ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ומן הצ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00480"><he>נְחוֹשֶׁת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ובלבד מן הצ׳ באותו הלילה</he> but you cannot seize plates prepared for use that same night.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:11">Tosef. Keth. VII, 11</cite> <he>הצועה</he> ed. Zuck., read: <he>הצוֹאָה</he>.]
